title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**We help the world run better**  

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.  

We are seeking a talented AI Concept Developer to join the Application AI team within the Product \& Engineering board area.

 **What you’ll do:**

  

The role sits at the intersection of AI innovation, experience design, and engineering execution. You will shape and validate new interaction paradigms by using state\-of\-the\-art generative tools to rapidly produce UI concepts, functional prototypes, and intelligent behaviors. You’ll engage with product teams to understand needs, translate them into opportunity spaces, and turn those insights into AI\-driven UX concepts that can be validated, iterated, and built.

 **What you bring:**

  

You bring design skills, a strong technical foundation, and a natural ability to connect and collaborate with teams. Your curiosity drives you to uncover user needs unlocking collective creativity in workshops and discovery sessions. You are comfortable writing prompts, scripts, or lightweight code, exploring generative tools, prototype intelligent interfaces, and moving confidently from concept to iteration all while balancing innovation with practical impact.

 **Your strengths include:**

* Hybrid design/engineering mindset with experience building working prototypes.
* Experience with modern GenAI tools, including multimodal generation (UI layout, content, flows), design copilots, and agent\-based UX exploration.
* Facilitation skills to guide collaborative discovery sessions and uncover opportunities for AI augmentation.
* Comfort breaking complex problems into testable hypotheses and early technical experiments.
* Ability to communicate complex AI and UX ideas to diverse audiences through compelling narratives, visuals, and prototypes.
